label: Flying fish pectoral/SL >= 0.406 > other beloniforms (machine-proposed)
statement_en: Every measured flying fish has pectoral/SL at least 0.406, and every measured non-flying-fish beloniform (flying halfbeaks, halfbeaks, needlefish) at most 0.389: the groups do not overlap (n = 49 flying fish, 60 others).

lean.source:
/-- Flying-fish pectoral/SL minimum lies above the maximum of every other measured beloniform group. -/
structure FinRatioGap where
  flyingFishMinRatio : ℝ
  otherBeloniformMaxRatio : ℝ
  ff_lo : (0.406 : ℝ) ≤ flyingFishMinRatio
  other_hi : otherBeloniformMaxRatio ≤ (0.389 : ℝ)
  gap : otherBeloniformMaxRatio < flyingFishMinRatio

scope_note: Static mirror generated by dashboard/build-lean-api.mjs from lib/lean-source.mjs, the same loader the MCP tools (lean_laws_list, lean_law_get, lean_lawset_get) use. A law's status is a registry decision, not a truth value; "proved" means a Lean kernel proof about a model, never that the model describes an organism. Laws absent here are unchecked, not satisfied. Evaluation (lean_check) is not mirrored: the browser runs blueprint3d/browser-check.mjs locally via lean-client.js.
